_comment: Round RPG15b: the Hint button's words (rpg/hints.py). The first entry whose 'if' conditions all hold is said; the last has none. Claude's draft, Karl edits. Round RPG16b: the *_night / *_dusk entries say where Hesk and Pell are after dark (review R8). Round RPG17: night_inn names resting until dusk too (Karl 24 Oct). A page holds 3 lines of 34 characters.

say: The Grave Priest is beaten. Tell Elder Hesk. At night he is at home, east of the duel hall.
The Grave Priest is beaten. Go back to Lantern Hollow and tell Elder Hesk in the square.
The Grave Priest is beaten. Tell Elder Hesk: at night he is at home, east of the duel hall.
The Grave Priest is beaten. Elder Hesk in Lantern Hollow's square will want to hear it.
The road is clear: {count:lamplighters_debt} of {goal:lamplighters_debt} Ember Bandits beaten. Tell Pell in Lantern Hollow.
The Grave Priest waits in the big hall to the north-east of this floor.
Walk into him to duel. Build your deck first if you aren't ready.
The stairs down are in the far south-east chamber of this floor. The Grave Priest is below.
Nothing more waits down here. The stairs up by the entrance lead back to the moor.
The Grave Priest is gone. The way back up is in the south-west corner of this floor.
Ember Bandits stand on the road: {count:lamplighters_debt} of {goal:lamplighters_debt} beaten. Walk into one to duel.
The old mill is up the path north-east of the road. Its stairs go down to the Warrens.
Both jobs are out on the moor. Leave Lantern Hollow by the east road.
Ember Bandits stand on the road: {count:lamplighters_debt} of {goal:lamplighters_debt} beaten. The old mill is north-east.
The old mill is up the path north-east of the road. Its stairs go down to the Warrens.
Hesk asked you to look under the old mill, north-east on the moor. Leave by the east road.
Ember Bandits stand on the road: {count:lamplighters_debt} of {goal:lamplighters_debt} beaten. Walk into one to duel.
Pell's Ember Bandits are on the moor's road. Leave by the east road. {count:lamplighters_debt} of {goal:lamplighters_debt} beaten.
Talk to the people of Lantern Hollow first. Walk up to someone and press Enter.
Elder Hesk had a job for you. At night he is at home, the house east of the duel hall.
Elder Hesk had a job for you. Talk to him again in the square to take it.
Pell the lamplighter needs help. From dusk he lights the lamps by the duel hall.
Pell the lamplighter needs help. Talk to him again, north of the square.
Elder Hesk may have work for you. At night he is at home, the house east of the duel hall.
Elder Hesk in the town square may have work for you.
Pell the lamplighter has a job for strong hands. From dusk he lights the lamps by the duel hall.
Pell the lamplighter, north of the square, has a job for strong hands.
You have finished the story so far. Keeper Brann in the duel hall offers rematches.
Buy cards and packs in the shops and build your deck from the Menu.
It is night. Marta at the inn lets you sleep until morning. By day she lets you rest until dusk.
Old Wendel sells cards and Ysolde sells packs. Build your deck from the Menu.
